an1.150:1.1: Another ten roots of dispute, this time equivalent to [an10.43](). | This section deals with technicalities of Vinaya. This emphasis suggests that these portions, and perhaps the Book of the Ones as a whole, was designed as a primer for newly-ordained monastics. If so, it would follow on from the Khuddakapāṭha (“Basic Passages”, Kp 1), which was a textbook for novices. Generally, for technical Vinaya terms I follow the renderings of Brahmali.
